faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q_steering: Why doesn't my steering wheel move in the Controls tab?
faq.a_steering: Make sure your device is detected in Settings > Controls. Sometimes restarting QARL or unplugging/replugging the wheel is enough. Also check the console (F12) to see if the device is listed.
faq.q_files: Where are my race files generated?
faq.a_files: The 'race.ini' file and weather plans are generated in 'Documents/Assetto Corsa/cfg'.
faq.q_pure: How does Pure work in QARL?
faq.a_pure: QARL reads your existing Pure plans or creates new ones in 'extension/config-ext/PurePlanner'. A temporary file is injected if necessary so the game loads the correct weather, then it is cleaned up on exit.
faq.q_steam: Why is my Steam ID important?
faq.a_steam: It allows the game to identify you correctly during multiplayer sessions. Without it, online servers will refuse the connection.
faq.a_csp: CSP is a major extension for Assetto Corsa. It drastically improves graphics, adds advanced weather effects, improves physics, and allows for extensive visual customization.
faq.a_csp_qarl: QARL's CSP tab allows you to modify your configuration files (like graphics settings or FSR/DLSS modules) safely. QARL always creates a backup (.bak) before modifying anything. You can also save and load your own presets.

option_labels.Desktop scale (for setups with multiple: Desktop scale (for setups with multiple monitors with different pixel densities)
option_labels.CARS_WITH_LIGHTS: Cars casting lights (to save FPS, you can have only limited number of cars casting light)
option_labels.DISABLE_MIRRORING: (collapse all headlights and brakelights by default)
option_labels.DISABLE_MIRRORING_FIRSTPERSON: Disable mirroring in first person view (turn both headlights into one while driving in first person view)
option_labels.CARS_SHADOWS: Cars with shadows (with zero, selected car wouldn’t cast shadows as well)
option_labels.SPECTATING_CARS_SHADOWS: Cars with shadows in replay (or without a focused car, like with free or track camera)
option_labels.CARS_IN_TRACK_SHADOWS: Include car shadows in track lights’ shadows (if disabled, forces all shadows to operate in static mode)
option_labels.DETAILED_SHADOWS_FROM_CARS_NEARBY: Detailed car shadows (number of closest cars casting detailed shadows instead of using a single call with LOD D or collider mesh)
option_labels.SOFT_PARTICLES: Soft particles (reduces clipping by using depth buffer to blend particles nicely)
option_labels.REWORKED_HEAT_SHIMMER: Updated heat shimmer (adds more sources and more conditions for heat shimmer, requires restart)
option_labels.NEW_HEATING: New heating calculation (to ensure smoke works the same for all cars in the session, CSP estimates tyre temperature using the data available for all)
option_labels.USE_DOWNSCALING: Render in half resolution when possible
option_labels.QUANTITY_SCALE: Quantity limit (limits amount of particles next to each other)
option_labels.SIMPLIFIED_SHADING: Simplified shading (can help with FPS for some low-end GPUs)
option_labels.FILL_SCREEN: Cover view in smoke when camera is deep in it
option_labels.RESET_WITH_NEW_SESSION: Reset with new session in multi-session race
option_labels.fixes_depth_fighting_artifacts_improves_: Fixes depth fighting artifacts, improves LODs, fixes MSAA, optionally replaces FXAA by CMAA, adds post-processing refraction and more.
option_labels.adds_procedurally_generated_grass_might_: Adds procedurally generated grass. Might be pretty expensive, especially with extra density enabled.
option_labels.skip_loading_of_old_grass_meshes_might_s: Skip loading of old grass meshes (might slightly increase loading speed and decrease RAM and VRAM consumption)
option_labels.use_smoother_blending_with_msaa_negative: Use smoother blending with MSAA (negatively affects performance)
option_labels.ALLOW_IN_TRIPLE: Allow in triple or other multi-view modes (be aware, it’s a major performance hit)
option_labels.ALLOW_IN_VR: Allow in VR (very experimental. For now, only SSLR and temporal upscalers are really functional. A few more effects will be available soon.)
option_labels.DEPTH_FIX2: Compatibility fix (might affect performance in strange ways)
option_labels.DISTANCE_MULT: Distance multiplier (distance multiplier for distant blur)
option_labels.EMISSIVE: Glowing emissives (require configuring in car or track config)
option_labels.disable_for_interior_cameras_for_open_wh: Disable for interior cameras (for open wheelers)
option_labels.active_set_to_0_to_disable_extra_fx: Active (set to 0 to disable Extra FX)
option_labels.cars_light_bouncing_off_cars_onto_surrou: Cars (light bouncing off cars onto surrounding geometry)
option_labels.tracks_light_bouncing_off_track_surfaces: Tracks (light bouncing off track surfaces back up, only for configured tracks)
option_labels.BLOCK_UNTRUSTED_NETWORKING: Block car and track scripts from accessing web (if you're using mods from particularly untrustworthy sources and don't want for your IP address to leak, enable this option. It will break some extensions such as Android Auto. Note: online servers will still be able to get your IP address and do web requests.)
option_labels.USE_MMF: Media playback (allows to play videos and additional audio in-game. Note: disabling this option might break some Lua apps, scripts and visual effects.)
option_labels.CRASH_PLUGIN: Use separate process for crash messages (experimental, ensures AC would shut down before showing an error message. In VR, always active.)
option_labels.CLEAR_SHADERS_CACHE2: Purge shaders cache (helps with game freezing when loading or exiting)
option_labels.CLEAR_CSP_CACHE: Clear CSP cache when CSP version changes (doesn't remove upgraded textures or cars data, but clears out some other things)
option_labels.ADAPTER_NAME: Internet adapter name (if you have multiple internet connections and want to choose a specific one for AC, specify its name or IP address here...).
option_labels.LOOPBACK_SERVERS: Loopback servers (AC starts two servers... With this checkbox, they would become loopback servers, available only for software running from this machine, slightly improving loading speed and hiding unnecessary distractions)
option_labels.CHECK_FOR_RAPID_CRASHES: Check for unhandled crashes at launch (disable if those "Did Assetto Corsa just crash?" messages are getting in a way)
option_labels.CRASH_ON_F12: Crash AC on Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Win+F10 (if AC freezes, press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Win+F10 to crash it and get a dump)
option_labels.RELEASE_DPAD: Stop AC from using D-Pad in quick pits menu
option_labels.UNBIND_TURBO_DIGITS: Stop digits from changing turbo setting
option_labels.AI_DRIVER_KEEP_SETTINGS: Stop autopilot from altering car settings
option_labels.USE_RAW_INPUT: Use raw input for mouse steering
option_labels.TOGGLE_WITH_MIDDLE_BUTTON: Use middle mouse button to toggle mouse steering
option_labels.RMB_FOR_ROTATING: Rotate camera with right mouse button
option_labels.RAW_INPUT_CAM: Use raw input for mouse-based cameras
option_labels.ALTER_DAMAGED_ENGINE_AUDIO: Slightly tweak audio for damaged engines
option_labels.POSTPONE_WALLS_INIT: Do not wait for walls to be ready
option_labels.OPTIMIZE_COLLIDERS: Optimize colliders of track physics objects
option_labels.RAW_INPUT: Use raw input for mouse-based cameras
option_labels.ODE_BATCH_RAYCAST: Use ODE for multiple contact point lookups
option_labels.HIGHBEAMS_FLASHING: Flash with high beams without low beams
option_labels.AVERAGE_PHYSICS_STATE: Average physics state between graphics frames
option_labels.ASYNC_CONFIG_TEXTURES: Load textures for CSP configs in parallel
option_labels.WIC_TEXTURES_LOADING: New loader for PNG and JPEG textures
option_labels.NEW_VINTAGE_LOADING: New loader for vintage DDS textures
option_labels.POSTPONABLE_OPTIONALS: Delay optional stuff to smooth out frame times
option_labels.SKIP_OVERLY_DETAILED: Skip meshes hidden by video settings
option_labels.STRIP_PHYSICS_DATA: Strip unnecessary data from physics meshes
option_labels.SAVE_BEST_LAPTIME: Save best lap time with ghost
option_labels.ADD_EXTRA_GLOW: Add extra glow to the ghost
option_labels.REDUCE_GFORCES_WHEN_SLOW: Reduce G-forces for cars slower than 6 km/h
option_labels.RENDER_HIGHEST_PRIORITY: Use highest thread priority for rendering
option_labels.MCCSS_PRIORITY_RENDER: Register rendering in Multimedia Class Scheduler
option_labels.MCCSS_PRIORITY_PHYSICS: Register physics in Multimedia Class Scheduler
option_labels.CUSTOM_ERRORS_HANDLING: Custom errors handling for Python apps
option_labels.CUSTOM_ERRORS_HANDLING_MESSAGES: Show popup messages for first errors
option_labels.REPROJECT_PARTIAL: Reproject partially updated cubemap (makes one face per frame feel like six)
option_labels.RESOLUTION2: Main resolution (with physically-based sampling large cubemaps can make things slow and mess up shading)
option_labels.CACHE: Caching (improves loading speed, reduces VRAM and RAM consumption)
option_labels.AUTOSELECT_RAIN_TYRES: Select rain tyres automatically (at the start of the drive only)
option_labels.DEBLUR_PAUSED_RAINDROPS: Disable rain drops blur when paused

option_labels.WHEEL_MAX_NM: Wheel peak torque (use same value as your wheel’s peak torque)
option_labels.ENABLE_FOR_ALL: Override car setting (forces real-feel on, essentially disabling the power steering on a car not using extended physics)
option_labels.BRAKE_MAX_KG: Max pedal force (Maximum pedal force that the user's brake pedal is currently set to. NOT the force at the load cell, but the force at the pedal face.)
option_labels.BRAKE_MAX_INACTIVE_PERC: Max percentage w/o data (If the car does not have the required data/code to use Real Feel entered in its physics files, this is the maximum percentage of your current pedal force that will be used. For example, if your pedals are set to 100kg, but if a car isn't enabled, you only want to push 60kg for 100% pressure, set this to 60%.)
option_labels.CLAMP_FORCES: Clamp brake forces (If the user's brake pedal is set to a lower force than the car's maximum, limit the brake torque to what would be possible in the real car at that pedal force. If unchecked, scales the pedal so the user can always push it to the car's maximum.)
option_labels.ADAPTIVE_FFB: Adaptive FFB performance (ensure FFB never slows down physics by automatically adjusting rate, or submitting packets in background)
option_labels.STRUT_FFB_ADJUSTMENT2: MacPherson strut FFB adjustment (applied to a few rare cars with a certain unusual configuration for more accurate behavior, wouldn’t affect Kunos cars)
option_labels.ALLOW_PYTHON_OVERRIDE: Allow Python apps to set custom thresholds
option_labels.BACKGROUND_PAUSE: Idle in background (lowers FPS when AC is in background to save battery and lower CPU and GPU consumption)
option_labels.EFFICIENCY_MODE: Activate efficiency mode when idling in background
option_labels.EFFICIENCYMODE: Activate efficiency mode when idling in background
option_labels.OLD_WINDOW: Old window (old method of creating a window for AC to be drawn into, misses some of new features)
option_labels.OLD_SWAPCHAIN: Old swap chain (old method of initializing rendering, less efficient and misses some of more modern features)
option_labels.EXCLUSIVE_FULLSCREEN: Allow exclusive fullscreen (not recommended, might cause crashes with Discord overlay)
option_labels.ALLOW_STRETCHING: Allow uneven stretching in fullscreen (with this option disabled, aspect ratio will be conserved no matter the resolution in fullscreen)
option_labels.OLD_STRETCH: Old final stretching (new final stretching is applied with non-default pixel density, or if post-processing is disabled, but MSAA is enabled. The new one, which this checkbox would disable, is sharper than old one, and more compatible with G-sync)
option_labels.ADVANCED_PACING: Pace frames better (ask driver to pause AC for a bit so that render would start at a perfect time, thus minimizing input lag)
option_labels.MAXIMUM_LATENCY_ADVANCED: Maximum latency (set to 1 for the lowest latency at the cost of FPS, or to 2 for a generally recommended value low-latency value)
option_labels.MAXIMUM_LATENCY_BASE: Maximum latency (use 0 for default, which is usually 3)
option_labels.VSYNC_MODE: V-sync mode (experimental tweak, not available with old swap chain. Note: with new swap chain, tearing won’t ever appear again with V-sync disabled as well)
option_labels.VSYNC_ADAPTIVE: Adaptive V-sync (pause syncing when FPS drops below display refresh rate)
option_labels.ALLOW_VRR: VRR / uncapped FPS (in Auto mode, allows uncapped FPS if VRR is enabled in GPU drivers or system settings. If you enable uncapped FPS explicitly, it might cause tearing if VRR is not enabled in system settings)
option_labels.FORCED_VSYNC_AWARE: Account for forced V-sync (make CSP more compatible with forced V-sync in GPU driver settings, experimental. Basically, stops CSP from doing frame limiting on its own, and switches to a different V-sync mechanism to make sure that option wouldn’t lead to increased CPU usage.)
option_labels.SAVE_WINDOW: Save window position and size (if resized, changes resolution in AC video settings)
option_labels.CONFINE_CURSOR: Confine cursor to window (prevent mouse cursor from leaving AC window, active only if window is focused)
option_labels.SET_TOPMOST: Topmost window (force AC window to always stay on top of others)
option_labels.FORCE_FOCUSED: Always focused (force AC window to never lose focus)
option_labels.BORDERLESS_WINDOWED: Hide window border (hide window frame for non-fullscreen state)
option_labels.VERIFY: Verify if HDR is available (do not disable this option unless you know what you’re doing)
option_labels.USE_FILTER_VALUES: Use PP-filter HDR-related values if defined
option_labels.USEFILTERVALUES: Use PP-filter HDR-related values if defined
option_labels.DRIVER_NAMES_ON_LICENSE_PLATES_ONLINE: Show driver names on license plates online (compatible cars only, experimental, might and will misbehave in some cases)
option_labels.DRIVERNAMESONLICENSEPLATESONLINE: Show driver names on license plates online
option_labels.HIDE_DRIVER_IN_CARS_WITH_HSHIFTER_IN_VR: Hide driver in cars with H-shifter in VR
option_labels.HIDEDRIVERINCARSWITHHSHIFTERINVR: Hide driver in cars with H-shifter in VR
option_labels.HIDE_DRIVER_SUIT: Hide driver and leave only gloves (affects first person view only)
option_labels.HIDEDRIVERSUIT: Hide driver and leave only gloves
option_labels.SHOW_DRIVER_AND_HANDS_IN_VR: Show driver and steering wheel in VR (in case you usually have them hidden, but want to see them in VR)
option_labels.SHOWDRIVERANDHANDSINVR: Show driver and steering wheel in VR
option_labels.DESATURATING_COLLISIONS: Desaturate colors on collisions (requires active post-processing)
option_labels.HIDE_MISSING_DRIVER_MODELS: Hide missing driver models (might help if driver looks very wrong due to mismatched rig)
option_labels.LIMIT_TRACK_OBJECTS_IN_REPLAYS: Limit track objects replays recording (stop AC from saving replays of track objects if there are more than 50, temporary. Use it if allocating replay size takes a ton of memory on your PC)
option_labels.SHOW_IMPORTANT_STEERING_WHEELS: Show hidden steering wheels if they have some important things on them
option_labels.SHOWIMPORTANTSTEERINGWHEELS: Show hidden steering wheels if they have some important things on them
option_labels.PYTHON_APPS_EXTENSION: Add missing proTyres definitions (updates tyre definitions of proTyres app during loading, adds rain tyres to it)
option_labels.USE_TTS_FOR_CHAT: Text-To-Speech for chat (only for messages from other drivers)
option_labels.TTS_ENGINE: Text-to-Speech engine (used by TTS for chat and other scripts that might need TTS)
option_labels.TURN_HEAD_WITH_FREE_CAMERA: Turn driver head with free and orbit camera (by default only active with regular driving cameras)
option_labels.TURNHEADWITHFREECAMERA: Turn driver head with free and orbit camera
option_labels.PAUSE_IN_BACKGROUND: Pause AC in background (not available online)
option_labels.FIX_SETUP_SORTING: Fix setup tabs sorting (put advanced suspension settings behind main suspension settings)
option_labels.DISABLE_DAMAGE_DIRT: Disable damage and dirt on car materials
option_labels.DISABLEDAMAGEDIRT: Disable damage and dirt on car materials
option_labels.RECONNECT_WHEEL_ON_APP_RESTORE: Reconnect to a wheel when AC is restored from background (might help with strange Logitech behavior)
option_labels.RECONNECTWHEELONAPPRESTORE: Reconnect to a wheel when AC is restored from background
option_labels.SET_CEF_PRIORITY: Increase priority for web engine process (might solve performance issues on Windows 11 with HAGS active)
option_labels.SETCEFPRIORITY: Increase priority for web engine process
option_labels.ANDROID_AUTO_TAKE_SCREENSHOT: Enable Android Auto screenshots (hold gas, brake and handbrake to take a screenshot. Funny meme, but it caused a lot of headache, sorry about that.)
option_labels.HIDDEN_STEERING_WHEEL_MODEL: KN5 for hidden steering wheel (If set, CSP will use this model instead when original steering wheel is hidden. It might help if you want to mask out original wheel and use image from passthrough cameras instead. Note: for masking to work properly, you’d need to set mesh to be emissive, and you might need to tune emissive color for your WeatherFX style.)
option_labels.CHECK_INTEL_BUG: Check Intel CPUs (if 13th and 14th generation of Intel CPU is detected, check if BIOS is updated to prevent CPU breaking)
option_labels.DISABLE_AUDIO: Disable audio in showroom mode (improves loading speed)
option_labels.NR_PASSES: Neural Rendering passes (apply DLSS 5 on top of rendered car preview)
option_labels.OLD_CSP_PREVIEWS_RENDER: Old CSP previews render (incorrect and mismatched with CM showroom, but if you want for things to look closer to CSP 0.2, use this option)
option_labels.DISABLE_TELEPORT_TO_PITS: Disable teleporting back to pits outside of pitstop
option_labels.DISABLETELEPORTTOPITS: Disable teleporting back to pits outside of pitstop
option_labels.AUTOCONNECT: Auto-connect to linked Mumble servers online (servers can specify a Mumble server for clients to automatically connect to)
option_labels.AUTOCLOSE: Automatically close Mumble if CSP started it (terminates Mumble process on exit if it was started by CSP)
option_labels.DIRECT_PASS: Pass texture data to OBS directly (requires an Assetto Corsa OBS plugin to be installed)
option_labels.DIRECTPASS: Pass texture data to OBS directly
option_labels.HIGH_QUALITY: Quality of built-in OBS views (other apps can add extra views, and it’s up to those apps how to render them)
option_labels.ORPHAN_TTS: Run TTS in orphan process (allows to capture audio from TTS separately. Makes it more difficult to debug errors in case something stops working.)
option_labels.ALT_IMPLEMENTATION: Alternative implementation (choose a variant based on your use case. If you’re just starting to use TrackIR, use the latest option with all the corrections. If you already have everything configured, keep the default value)
option_labels.EYES_POSITION: Eyes position (relative to neck node; used for auto-alignment)
option_labels.LOAD_REMOTE: Load remote models (automatically load models for remote drivers)
option_labels.DRIVER_MODEL_KEY: Your driver model (in <List ID>/<Model ID> format)
option_labels.Adjust MIP bias (adds extra MIP bias for: Adjust MIP bias (adds extra MIP bias for side splits)
option_labels.ALWAYS_SHOW_DRIVER_NAMES: Show driver names in all camera modes (by default only shown with cockpit, car or free camera)
option_labels.ALWAYSSHOWDRIVERNAMES: Show driver names in all camera modes
option_labels.SYNC_WITH_DISPLAY: Sync pace with display (adjust in-game Δt to match the headset timing, experimental)
option_labels.USE_SINGLE_POSTPROCESSING_PASS: Single YEBIS pass (instead of running post-processing individually for each eye, runs it once for both. Disables sun rays. If glare effects are wide, they might leak from one eye to another.)
option_labels.VRS_RATE: VRS rate (for best results, set MSAA accordingly)
option_labels.VRS_GAZE_ALIGN_EYES: Align with eyes (ensure detailed regions are aligned with forward direction)
option_labels.USE_ASW2: Use ASW 2.0 (uses depth buffer for smoother VR extrapolation)
option_labels.EXIT_AWARE: Exit-aware (shut down AC when chosen to from VR)
option_labels.UPDATE_MANIFEST: Update manifest (experimental, fixes Assetto Corsa name and icons in Oculus UI)
option_labels.UPDATE_MANIFEST_RACE_DETAILS: Show details about car and track during loading
option_labels.UPDATEMANIFESTRACEDETAILS: Show details about car and track during loading
option_labels.SUBMIT_FIRST: Frame order (this option affects responsiveness and performance)
option_labels.LOADING_DETAILS: During loading, show race details in the headset
option_labels.LOADINGDETAILS: During loading, show race details in the headset
option_labels.SAVE_RECENTRE: Restore recentre from the last session
option_labels.SAVERECENTRE: Restore recentre from the last session
option_labels.SHOW_CONTROLLERS_LINE: Render controllers directions as blue lines
option_labels.SHOWCONTROLLERSLINE: Render controllers directions as blue lines
option_labels.CONTROLLERS_RIG: Move driver model hands with controllers
option_labels.CONTROLLERSRIG: Move driver model hands with controllers
option_labels.NO_MIRROR: Do not show HUD on main screen
option_labels.NOMIRROR: Do not show HUD on main screen
option_labels.ONLY_IN_FIRST_PERSON: Visible only in first person view
option_labels.ONLYINFIRSTPERSON: Visible only in first person view
option_labels.ENSURE_AC_IS_NOT_CROPPED: Ensure AC window is not cropped
option_labels.ENSUREACISNOTCROPPED: Ensure AC window is not cropped
option_labels.ALLOW_TO_CHANGE_FILTERS: Allow to change current PP-filter in photo mode app
option_labels.ALLOWTOCHANGEFILTERS: Allow to change current PP-filter in photo mode app
option_labels.HUD_REPLAY_TWEAK: Move original HUD with camera for replay modes
option_labels.HUDREPLAYTWEAK: Move original HUD with camera for replay modes
option_labels.FRAMES_MARGIN: Margin between frames (increased margin reduces post-processing issues on edges)
option_labels.SWITCH_WIPERS_WITH_AI: Turn wipers on and off automatically
option_labels.SWITCHWIPERSWITHAI: Turn wipers on and off automatically
option_labels.USE_COMPATIBLE_SKY_SHADER: Use compatible sky shader (on newer systems, disabling this option might increase FPS by 2%)
option_labels.ADDITIONAL_EFFECTS: Extra visual effects (weather scripts can create custom visual effects, this option can turn it off if needed)
option_labels.SLOW_REFLECTIONS_UPDATE: Update sky in reflections less often
option_labels.SLOWREFLECTIONSUPDATE: Update sky in reflections less often
option_labels.FORCE_ONLINE_HEADLIGHTS: Force headlights for other drivers online
option_labels.FORCEONLINEHEADLIGHTS: Force headlights for other drivers online
option_labels.SWITCH_HEADLIGHTS_WITH_AI: Turn headlights on and off automatically
option_labels.SWITCHHEADLIGHTSWITHAI: Turn headlights on and off automatically
option_labels.INCLUDE_EMISSIVES: Include emissive meshes in static cubemap
option_labels.INCLUDEEMISSIVES: Include emissive meshes in static cubemap
option_labels.INCREASE_CONDITIONS_LIMITS: Allow to set wind speed above 35 km/h or temperature outside of regular range
option_labels.INCREASECONDITIONSLIMITS: Allow to set wind speed above 35 km/h
option_labels.ALT_DEPTH_FOR_CAR_BOX_VS_TRACK: Alt depth for car box vs track
option_labels.CRASH_WHEN_TRYING_TO_MOVE_CURSOR2: Crash when trying to move cursor
option_labels.WRONG_WAY_ALLOW_IN_TRACKDAY: Wrong way allow in track day
option_labels.AI_FLOOD_MIN_DISTANCE_TO_PLAYER: AI flood min distance to player
option_labels.NO_XR_SWAPCHAIN_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT: No XR swapchain usage transfer dst bit

module_descriptions.extra_fx: A secondary rendering pass, allowing to add more visual effects. To get it to work, make sure post-processing is enabled, and original AC motion blur is disabled.
